text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 23, 2024, Appeal DDRT2025-02

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Accepted the request from the Representative, Adam Prewer, Epstein Cole LLP, on behalf of the Appellant Melanie Kraft, withdrawing the appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 23, 2024, Appeal DDRT2025-02. 2. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the Order, October 23, 2024, Appeal DDRT2025-02, remain in effect.
